topics.topic: Indian Coast Guard Ship Samudra Pratap

Samudra Pratap enhances maritime surveillance and response capabilities.
Coast Guard plays major role in EEZ monitoring.

Ship supports pollution-control and search-and-rescue operations.
India’s coastline and strategic sea lanes require constant monitoring.
Blue Economy linked with secure maritime environment.

Search and Rescue operations coordinated through maritime mechanisms.
Indian Ocean Region strategically significant for global shipping.

Part of broader coastal-security modernisation efforts.
